description: This file contains functions related to parsing, formatting, and handling HTTP date strings, including RFC 7231 and other date formats. It provides date parsing utilities, date string conversion, and checks for HTTP 'If-Modified-Since' headers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ const char * http_date_parse_RFC_850(const char * s,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Parses dates in RFC 850 format and populates the tm structure.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ const char * http_date_parse_asctime(const char * const s,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Parses asctime() date strings into the tm structure.

methods.name: const char * http_date_parse_IMF_fixdate(const char * const s,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Parses IMF-fixdate format date strings into the tm structure.

methods.name: const char * http_date_str_to_tm(const char * const s,const uint32_t len,struct tm * const tm)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a date string in various HTTP date formats into tm structure.

methods.name: uint32_t http_date_time_to_str(char * const s,const size_t sz,const unix_time64_t t)
methods.description: Converts a unix time to an HTTP-formatted date string.

methods.name: int http_date_if_modified_since(const char * const ifmod,const uint32_t ifmodlen,const unix_time64_t lmtime)
methods.description: Checks if the resource has been modified since the date specified in the If-Modified-Since header.
